explanation: The blockade article says what it did to the French position: "In the north of the country, the French forces were isolated in the two large ports of Cap-Français and Môle-Saint-Nicolas and a few smaller settlements, all supplied by a French naval force based primarily at Cap-Français", and later that "by the end of the month, the garrison was starving". The Vertières article describes Rochambeau "at bay" at Cap-Français with 5,000 troops. Enabled and not caused: the sea blockade left the last French army fixed and unsupplied where the battle was fought, and neither article says it won the battle. Probable: Wikipedia alone.
